# eventhub: agent instructions

This is a Karni project. Karni already implements everything generic, so you write
only domain code.

Before any work, run these two commands and follow what they return:

1. `karni context` prints the live inventory: apps, models, viewsets, UI components,
   hooks, pages and installed modules.
2. `karni rules` prints the conventions, each with a stable code (K###, or P### for
   the project's own).

While you work:

- Run `karni rules --check <file>` on every file you write and fix each violation it prints.
- Use `karni rules --procedure <name>` for routine tasks: new-model, new-page, add-module, new-module.
- Run `karni check` before committing. Every enforced rule fails the build.

If the `karni` command is unavailable, say so and stop. Do not guess the conventions.

## Module guidance

<!-- karni:module:payments -->
## Payments (karni-payments)
- Checkout, refunds and webhook-driven state ship ready-made. Never call
  provider SDKs (stripe/razorpay) directly. Go through `karni_payments.services`.
- NEVER trust client amounts: set `KARNI_PAYMENTS_CHECKOUT_VALIDATOR` (dotted
  path) to enforce server-side pricing, or override the checkout action.
- Wire URLs once in config/urls.py:
  `path("payments/", include("karni_payments.urls"))`
- API rides the auto-router: `/api/payments/` + `checkout/` (POST) +
  `{id}/refund/` (POST, role `payments-admin`), `/api/refunds/` (same role).
- Settings arrive via the module's settings fragment. Env vars:
  KARNI_PAYMENTS_PROVIDER (stripe|razorpay|test|dotted path),
  KARNI_PAYMENTS_CURRENCY, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET,
  RAZORPAY_KEY_ID, RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET, RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET.
- Webhook state changes run in Celery, so keep the worker service running.
